name: yuzread
description: Yuzread suite: independent Reader, Library and Downloader applications sharing one Electron runtime

scripts.postinstall: npm run build:electron && node electron-built/prepare-types.cjs && node electron-built/install-electron.cjs
scripts.runtime: npm run build:electron && node electron-built/prepare-types.cjs && node electron-built/install-electron.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.screen.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check:code: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run check:contracts
scripts.build:portable: npm run build && npm run build:suite-runtime && node electron-built/SuitePortable.cjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:contracts && npm run build:electron && npm run build:screen
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:suite-runtime && node electron-built/SuiteLauncher.cjs
scripts.start:reader: npm run build && npm run build:suite-runtime && .runtime\suite-runtime\yuzread-reader.exe .
scripts.start:library: npm run build && npm run build:suite-runtime && .runtime\suite-runtime\yuzread-library.exe .
scripts.start:downloader: npm run build && npm run build:suite-runtime && .runtime\suite-runtime\yuzread-downloader.exe .
scripts.inspect: npm run build && npm run build:suite-runtime && .runtime\suite-runtime\yuzread-reader.exe . --inspect-layout
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.screen.json --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
